compiled_state.title: [reconciler/applier]: create_one add_comment failure not surfaced in batch_outcome -> observability gap
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Companion to 6afc. The outbound UPDATE path (update_one, _apply_outbound_update) now surfaces swallowed add_comment failures via comment_errors. The CREATE path (create_one, applier.py:2145-2148) still catches+logs add_comment failures without surfacing them in the batch_outcome. Convergence is NOT affected (the next pass routes the bound issue through the fixed _diff_comments), but operator observability of create-path comment failures remains a gap. Low priority.

comments.body: CLI_user: user-directed fix. Classification: behavioral, Score 2 (BASIC: severity=0 observability-only, complexity=1, environment=1, flaky=0). Root cause documented in ticket; fix = mirror update-path comment_errors surfacing into create_one.
